requirements.title: An expression represents a data object reference or a computation
requirements.source: 10.1.1 p1, first sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p168.
requirements.definition: An expression denotes either a data object reference or a computation, and the value represented by the expression is scalar or array. This catalogue records that representational boundary without duplicating designator, variable, operation, or result interpretation rules.
requirements.oracle:
Future controls compare reached scalar or array values against independent literals after satisfying the owning designator, operation, and assignment rules. No test may infer expression representation from storage addresses or from a processor's chosen evaluation order.

Batch291 expressions runtime/diagnostic fixtures: one run/effect/f2023 program observes a declared scalar object value 17, the integer computation 2+5=7, a scalar integer expression value 42, and a rank-one array expression with shape [2] and values [3,5]. Each assertion has a separate conforming feature mutation changing the referenced object, operation, scalar literal, or array constructor value. No storage address, evaluation-order, real, or compiler-consensus oracle is used.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
The original source-only catalogue recorded pending plans only and created no Fortran test program, compiler invocation, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim; this generator supplies selected fixtures and mutation/diagnostic plans without granting unrelated approvals or claims. Numbered syntax rules and constraints carry the 4.2 diagnostic-capability duty, but future negative plans must isolate the cited rule or constraint and must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted code, undefined reads, or interpretation and evaluation rules owned by 10.1.3-10.1.12.

requirements.title: Evaluation of an expression produces a typed value with parameters and shape
requirements.source: 10.1.1 p1, second sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p168.
requirements.definition: When an expression is evaluated it produces a value, and that value has a type, has type parameters when appropriate, and has a shape. The detailed determination of those properties is delegated to the later expression-result subclauses.

pending.derived-type-parameter: PENDING positive-control source shape using a parameterized derived-type constructor or object expression with a known integer type parameter and querying it with a literal oracle. The plan must establish the parameter in the declaration or constructor, not infer it from component storage.

requirements.oracle:
Future plans must establish the source expression and then observe type, parameter, or shape through independently specified literals or inquiries whose own semantics are cited as dependencies.

Batch291 expressions runtime/diagnostic fixtures: one run/effect/f2023 program directly inquires on expressions: kind(40+2), len('ab'//'cde'), rank(21+1), and shape([8,13]). The integer kind is compared with kind(1), the character length with 5, scalar rank with 0, and array shape with [2]. Mutations change the expression under inquiry, not a variable assigned from it.

requirements.title: A non-variable expression has corank zero
requirements.source: 10.1.1 p1, third sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p168.
requirements.definition: The corank of an expression that is not a variable is zero. This does not redefine which expressions are variables, nor the separate rules for coarray variables and coindexed designators.

pending.literal-nonvariable-corank-zero: PENDING positive-control source shape passing a literal or literal expression to a context that can independently observe corank zero, with a scalar value literal oracle on the same path. The plan must cite the inquiry/context owner and must not infer corank from local execution alone.
pending.computed-nonvariable-corank-zero: PENDING positive-control source shape using a computed expression from coarray-capable declarations but not a variable, with a literal arithmetic oracle and an independently specified corank-zero inquiry or acceptance context. No address or image arithmetic is an oracle.
pending.parenthesized-variable-boundary: PENDING boundary source plan comparing a variable expression and a parenthesized variable expression only in contexts whose owners distinguish variable status. The non-vacuous observation is a literal value check plus the cited variable-context admission or rejection; variable status remains 9.2/10.1.8 dependent.

requirements.oracle: Future observations need an independently owned corank-sensitive context and a literal value check to prove execution. A coarray declaration alone is not evidence that a non-variable expression has nonzero corank.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Numbered syntax rules and constraints carry the 4.2 diagnostic-capability duty, but future negative plans must isolate the cited rule or constraint and must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted code, undefined reads, or interpretation and evaluation rules owned by 10.1.3-10.1.12.
